{{Top}}
A '''stabilizing ring''' was a component of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It was considered one of the easy obtainable parts, along with the [[Field energizer/Legends|field energizer]], [[Flux aperture/Legends|flux apertures]] and [[Power cell/Legends|Power packs]].
